text: Pentland Group describes itself as 'a family business building and delivering positive brands in sports, outdoor and fashion'; its Pentland Brands arm owns Canterbury ('It owns Speedo, Berghaus, Canterbury, Endura, ellesse, SeaVees, Red Or Dead and Mitre'). Bailiwick Express, reporting The Sunday Times, describes Pentland Group as 'owned by the billionaire Rubins family'.
short: Canterbury is owned by Pentland Brands, part of Pentland Group, a family business owned by the Rubin family.

additionalSources.quote: The Sunday Times says UK-based Pentland Group – owned by the billionaire Rubins family – was demerged last October into two Jersey entities.
